description: This source file defines the main application structure and delegate for an iOS app using SwiftUI. It handles app lifecycle events, background tasks, remote notifications, and interactions with watch prompt notifications, as well as integrating with the app's core model.

classes.name: OpenClawAppDelegate
classes.description: Manages application lifecycle, background tasks, push notifications, and interaction with watch prompts.

methods.name: application(_:didFinishLaunchingWithOptions:)
methods.description: Initializes background tasks, notification center delegate, and remote notification registration.

methods.name: application(_:didRegisterForRemoteNotificationsWithDeviceToken:)
methods.description: Handles successful remote notification registration by updating the app model or storing the device token.

methods.name: application(_:didFailToRegisterForRemoteNotificationsWithError:)
methods.description: Logs failure to register for remote notifications.

methods.name: application(_:didReceiveRemoteNotification:fetchCompletionHandler:)
methods.description: Processes incoming remote notifications, triggers app model wake handling, and schedules background refresh as needed.

methods.name: scenePhaseChanged(_:)
methods.description: Schedules background wake refresh when scene moves to background.

methods.name: registerBackgroundWakeRefreshTask()
methods.description: Registers the background wake refresh task with the system.

methods.name: scheduleBackgroundWakeRefresh(afterSeconds:reason:)
methods.description: Schedules a background refresh task with specified delay and reason.

methods.name: handleBackgroundWakeRefresh(task:)
methods.description: Handles execution of background wake refresh task, triggers app model background refresh, and manages task lifecycle.

methods.name: isWatchPromptNotification(_:) (static)
methods.description: Determines if user info corresponds to a watch prompt notification.

methods.name: parseWatchPromptAction(from:)
methods.description: Parses and extracts watch prompt actions from notification responses.

methods.name: routeWatchPromptAction(_:)
methods.description: Routes the parsed watch prompt action to be handled by the app model.

methods.name: userNotificationCenter(_:willPresent:withCompletionHandler:)
methods.description: Handles presentation options for notifications when app is in foreground.

methods.name: userNotificationCenter(_:didReceive:withCompletionHandler:)
methods.description: Handles notification responses, routes watch prompt actions if detected.
